title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Members and Missing-Box Fees Recovered from Store Credit
content:
In Gift Cards & Store Credit recoveries of instant Return Store Credit, the missing-box fee the recovery includes (the recovery's box-fee part) follows the customer's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership on the recovery date.

| Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership on the recovery date | Box-fee part of the recovery |
|---|---|
| Status trial or active, and the plan covers return labels | 0 of the booked missing-box fee (nothing) |
| Status trial or active, and the plan does not cover return labels | 0.5 of the booked missing-box fee (half), rounded half up to the cent |
| No membership in status trial or active | Not reduced by this benefit |

Both conditions are read from the customer's Unlimited holding: its status on the recovery date, and whether its plan covers return labels. A membership in any status other than trial or active counts as no membership for this benefit.

## Illustrations (hypothetical missing-box fee booked at 7.25)

| Unlimited position | Box-fee part |
|---|---|
| Active, plan covers return labels | 0.00 |
| Trial, plan covers return labels | 0.00 |
| Active, plan does not cover return labels | 3.63 (half of 7.25 is 3.625, rounded half up) |
| Membership in a status other than trial or active, or none | 7.25, not reduced |
